messages:
lara: Quick design sync 1: small update to playground convo UI. Figma: https://figma.com/file/zzz/playground-stream-badge. Decisions needed: inline stop visibility, compact token badge behavior during streaming, and keyboard-friendly pin for prompt cards.

sam: Inline stop as a small pill top-right of bubble sounds good. Add Esc shortcut to stop too. For token badge, compact numeric while streaming, expand on hover/focus.

kevin: Accessibility: stop must be in tab order, aria-label="Stop generation". Streaming text in aria-live="polite". Token updates should be debounced (~300ms) to avoid SR spam. Reduced-motion should disable any pulsing.

mia: QA: ensure inline stop doesn't block text selection on narrow layouts. If conflict, fallback to a floating global toolbar at bottom. Also add a keyboard action to pin prompt cards (context menu + "Pin to rail").

qa-bot: Added test checklist TKT-900: keyboard stop, token badge hover+focus, reduced-motion, mobile fallback.

sam: CSS idea: .msg-actions { position:absolute; top:6px; right:6px; } @media (max-width:600px){ .msg-actions{display:none} .global-toolbar{display:flex} }

lara: Copy: use "Regenerate response" and token tooltip text "Tokens used so far". Vote with reactions: :one: inline-by-default, :two: global-only.

sam: :one:

kevin: :one: + will add a11y notes to the PR.

mia: :one: + will coordinate tests.

lara: Decision: inline stop by default, fallback global toolbar <600px, compact token badge while streaming with hover/focus expand, keyboard pin option for prompt cards. Action items: sam -> PR for CSS + shortcuts, kevin -> a11y checklist, mia -> tests + figma update. Target: next sprint.
